Diventa parte di qualcosa di più grande. Collabora con oltre 2.000 specialisti provenienti da più di 100 professioni e consenti alle persone con paraplegia di condurre una vita autodeterminata. Un'atmosfera stimolante e una collaborazione interdisciplinare ad altezza d'occhio ti aspettano nel moderno campus di Nottwil. Hai la leadership nel sangue? Non vuoi semplicemente correre, vuoi contribuire a modellarlo, prendere decisioni e fare davvero la differenza? Allora questo potrebbe essere esattamente il tuo prossimo passo. In qualità di co-direttore della stazione, sei proprio nel mezzo invece che semplicemente lì. Insieme al co-direttore della stazione esistente, ti assumerai la responsabilità dell'intera stazione, del team, della qualità e di tutto ciò che mantiene le operazioni in funzione. E non dalla scrivania, ma da vicino: alle persone, alla vita di tutti i giorni, ai problemi reali - impegnativi e diversi, caratterizzati da spirito di squadra, professionalità e una buona dose di umorismo. Questi sono i tuoi compiti
• Dirigi il tuo team insieme al co-responsabile del reparto in modo chiaro, equo e paritario
• Tieni insieme i fili: organizzazione, pianificazione, processi
• Garantisci che la qualità venga vissuta
• Contribuisci con idee, metti in discussione e avvia cambiamenti
• Lavori in modo interprofessionale perché insieme si creano buone soluzioni
• Sei un modello, sparring partner e talvolta anche un risolutore di problemi Questo è ciò che ti distingue
• Diploma di specialista infermieristico HF/FH con esperienza di leadership
• Un cuore per la leadership e lo sviluppo
• Piacere di prendere responsabilità e capacità decisionale
• Talento organizzativo e capacità di mantenere una visione d'insieme anche in tempi frenetici
• Comunicazione chiara e corretta a livello degli occhi
• Coraggio di pensare le cose in modo diverso e provare cose nuove Questo è ciò che vi aspetta Chi siamo Il Centro svizzero per paraplegici di Nottwil è una clinica specializzata privata, riconosciuta a livello nazionale e internazionale per la medicina dei paraplegici, della schiena e delle vie respiratorie. In quanto clinica per malattie acute e riabilitative, il centro offre ai suoi pazienti un'assistenza completa e li sostiene per tutta la vita. • Guidate il vostro team insieme al co-responsabile del reparto in modo chiaro, equo e paritario. Requisiti:
• Diploma di specialista infermieristico HF/FH con esperienza di leadership
descriptionByLocale.en:
Become part of something bigger. Work with more than 2000 specialists from more than 100 professions and allow cross-sectionally paralysed people to have a self-determined life. An inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary cooperation awaits you at the modern campus in Nottwil. You have leadership in the blood? You don't just want to go along, you want to shape, decide and really move something? Then this could be your next step. As a co-station manager, you're in the middle of it instead of just there. Together with the existing co-station manager, you take responsibility for the entire station, for the team, for the quality and for everything that keeps running. Not from the desk, but close to it: to people, everyday life, to the real topics - demanding and varied, characterized by team spirit, professionalism and a good portion of humor. These are your tasks
• You guide your team with the Co-Station Manager clearly, fair and at eye level
• You hold the threads together: organization, planning, processes
• You make sure that quality is lived
• You bring ideas, question things and make changes
• You work interprofessional because good solutions are created together
• You are a model, Sparring partner*in and sometimes Troubleshooter That draws you
• Diploma as a nursing specialist HF/FH with leadership experience
• A heart for leadership and development
• Pleasure to take responsibility and make decisions
• Organizational talent and the ability to keep an overview even in hectic times
• Clear and fair communication at eye level
• Courage to think things differently and try something new It's waiting for you About us The Swiss Paraplegic Centre in Nottwil is a private, nationally and internationally recognized specialist clinic for cross-sectional, spinal and respiratory medicine. As an acute and rehabilitation clinic, the centre offers its patients comprehensive care and supports them for a lifetime. The clinic is part of the Swiss Paraplegic Group, which provides a worldwide unique service network for the holistic rehabilitation of people with paraplegic paralysis. Tasks:
• You guide your team with the Co-Station Manager clearly, fair and at eye level Requirements:
• Diploma as a nursing specialist HF/FH with leadership experience

Une atmosphère inspirante et une collaboration interdisciplinaire à hauteur de vue vous attendent sur le campus moderne de Nottwil. Le service informatique du Centre Suisse pour Paraplégiques assure des prestations informatiques pour l'ensemble du groupe des paraplégiques ainsi que pour d'autres clients. Ce sont vos tâches. Voici à quoi pourrait ressembler votre journée, mais ce n'est pas obligatoire. L’informatique est connue pour être créative et flexible en matière de planification quotidienne. 08h00 - Votre journée commence. Certains membres de l’équipe sont déjà dans le flow, d’autres arrivent confortablement. L'équipe est motivée, vous êtes au milieu et vérifiez les sujets les plus importants de votre monde d'application : la saisie des temps, les systèmes de caisse et les PowerApps innovantes. 09h30 - Échange passionnant avec un département. Vous écoutez, posez les bonnes questions et transformez les souhaits en solutions réalistes et réalisables. En tant que lien entre les services informatiques et les services spécialisés, vous êtes un traducteur, un facilitateur et parfois aussi un doux représentant de la réalité - toujours avec le sourire. 11h00 - Lors d'un appel avec un partenaire externe, vous suivez les choses. Versions, ajustements, tests – vous documentez les décisions et veillez à ce que chacun sache ce qui est mis en œuvre, pourquoi et comment. La transparence et la traçabilité sont une évidence pour vous. 12h00 - Pause déjeuner. Certains se promènent au soleil, d'autres vont à la piscine, certains philosophent autour d'un café. Tout peut, rien n’est obligé. L’essentiel est de se vider la tête. 13h00 - Poursuite du développement et de l'exploitation de vos applications. Vous accompagnez les changements, testez de nouvelles fonctionnalités, les approuvez et les documentez. Pas de chaos, pas de « seulement deux personnes savent », mais des solutions durables qui peuvent être comprises plus tard – même un lundi matin. 15h00 - Des demandes d'assistance ? Aucun problème! Le Service Desk est le premier point de contact, vous êtes l'autorité d'escalade et de résolution. Vous analysez, priorisez, mettez de l'ordre dans le sujet et vous coordonnez avec les professionnels internes de l'informatique et d'autres domaines. Vous prenez vos responsabilités et préférez résoudre vous-même les tickets plutôt que de les transmettre. 16h30 - L'heure du projet est en fin d'après-midi. Vous priorisez, coordonnez, engagez les parties prenantes et définissez les prochaines étapes. Vous anticipez afin d'éviter tout problème et rassemblez toutes les personnes impliquées. Ensemble, vous discutez des besoins, planifiez les mises à jour et lancez d'autres développements. 17h30 - Heure de fermeture. Les systèmes fonctionnent de manière stable, les points ouverts sont clairs et il y a peut-être un bref échange au sein de l'équipe – professionnellement ou privéement. Il y a de la place pour les deux. Et parfois, on trinque ensemble aux réussites de la journée, avec un apéritif bien sûr ! Ce qui vous distingue
• Vous avez une formation dans le domaine de l'informatique de gestion, que votre parcours soit traditionnel ou latéral.

Become part of something bigger. Work with over 2,000 specialists from more than 100 professions and enable people with paraplegia to lead a self-determined life. An inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary collaboration at eye level await you on the modern campus in Nottwil. Design care. Develop people. Move the future. Would you like to take the next step and take responsibility? Or have you felt for a while that leadership is exactly your thing, but haven't had the opportunity yet? You can get them from us. For one of our stations we are looking for a committed personality with organizational talent, a heart for people and a desire to help shape things. Leadership experience is welcome but not required. We promote talent with conviction and accompany you professionally in your leadership role. Our everyday care routine is diverse, dynamic and characterized by professionalism, team spirit and genuine collaboration at eye level. The diversity of our patients and employees enriches our daily work. These are your tasks As a group leader, you are a central part of our management team. You combine leadership with direct care, close to the team, close to the patients.

• actively shape everyday ward life
• take joint responsibility for personnel planning, organization and administrative processes
• strengthen interprofessional collaboration
• contribute ideas and work on projects
• further develop processes What sets you apart
• Diploma as a nursing specialist HF/FH
• Enjoy leadership tasks or the clear desire to develop into them
• Enthusiasm for the combination of leadership and direct care
• Strong communication skills, flexibility and organizational skills

The clinic belongs to the Swiss Paraplegic Group, which provides a globally unique service network for the holistic rehabilitation of people with spinal cord injury. • strengthen interprofessional collaboration
